WEB-265de0791057.summary: The FOREUM Topic Grant 2026 aims to stimulate innovative, high-impact research to understand, measure, and manage sleep disturbances in patients with rheumatic and musculoskeletal diseases (RMDs). Funded projects can be clinical, epidemiological, translational, or interventional, focusing on meaningful patient outcomes. The call requires multi-centre collaboration involving at least three different countries. Lead centres must be affiliated with their national EULAR association, and applicants may apply for up to 600,000 EUR for a maximum duration of 3 years.
